raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
> Kimi-K3 on gfx950 merge queue (all drafts; they land one at a time in this order): 1 #44978 verify argmax + tuned bf16 rows · 2 #44979 MLA prefill · 3 #44980 streaming AttnRes · 4 #44981 MoE prefill · 5 #44982 KDA · 6 #44983 MLA decode prep · 7 #44984 MLA decode epilogue · 8 #44985 LL column tail · 9 #44986 fused all-reduce read · 10 #44987 fused route sort · 11 #44988 split MoE front + bank partials · 12 #44989 MLA q-norm + q_b. Replaces #44547-#44553.
> Needs slots 1-10 (#44978 ... #44987); its branch carries them as commits — review only the last commit.

## Motivation

At decode sizes every rank of a Kimi-K3 MoE layer computes the whole replicated router and latent down-projection in
the merged front GEMM, and the next layer's attention-residual (AttnRes) reads re-score the same bank rows every
layer.

## Modifications

Gated on gfx950 with aiter (`SGLANG_USE_AITER`) and the TP8 LL communicator (`k3_ll_comm_hip.get_comm()`). Builds on
#44985's and #44986's LL collectives and fused reads, #44987's route sort, and #44981's `activated` input to the shared
experts (a SiTU an earlier kernel already computed).

- Column-parallel MoE front (`SGLANG_ROCM_K3_SPLIT_FRONT`, <= 64 tokens): each rank's front GEMM reads its shared
  gate_up and 1/8 of the router and latent down-projection rows; one LL all-gather (`comm/front_gather_hip.cuh`)
  assembles logits and latent and also runs the MXFP8 latent quant (staged for aiter's scale-only sort), the router
  top-k (from 16 tokens; the route sort then only sorts) and the shared experts' SiTU.
- AttnRes bank partials (`attn_res/bank_partial_hip.cuh`, `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_ATTN_RES_BANK_PARTIALS`, <= 16 rows): the
  route sort's spare workgroups compute the next layer's softmax partials over its bank rows (max, sum, fp32
  weighted sum) for both of its reads; the fused reads of #44985 and #44986 take them and fold in only the stream.

| New env var | Default |
|---|---|
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_SPLIT_FRONT` | on |
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_ATTN_RES_BANK_PARTIALS` | on |

## Accuracy Tests

**Setup for every number below:** 8x MI350X (gfx950, 1000 W), Kimi-K3 (MXFP4 MoE, bf16 attention) at TP8 with EAGLE3
(topk 1, 3 steps, 4 draft tokens), FP8 KV cache, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, aiter's K3 FlyDSL kernels
(`AITER_SITUV2_A8W4=1 AITER_FLYDSL_FORCE=1 SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT=1`), CUDA graphs for bs 1/2/4/8/16, and an aiter bf16 GEMM table with K3 rows re-tuned on this pod with HBM-resident weights
(`AITER_CONFIG_GEMM_BF16`; not part of this PR, it belongs in aiter's model configs). EAGLE3 on K3 needs the
aux-capture commit of #43599, applied locally for these runs. Microbenchmarks rotate their weights through HBM.
Per-feature numbers were measured on the integration branch of this series as each piece landed (Oct 13-14,
earlier `main`). All branches of the series are on `main` 4eb606b2ae (2026-10-17); the kernel tests below ran on this
branch, and the end-to-end checkpoints on that `main` plus the queue up to each slot.

- GSM8K 400: split front 0.985 / accept 3.62; front gather top-k + quant 0.9825 / 3.618; bank partials 0.985.
  End to end: see below.
- `test_kimi_k3_route_sort.py` (extended): the bank partials match torch.
- `test_k3_ll_collectives.py` (8 GPUs, extended): the front gather equals `dist.all_gather`, its quant / top-k / SiTU
  equal aiter's quant-sort, the route sort and `situ_and_mul`; reads that take the partials equal the reads over the
  bank. On MI350X, with #44985's and #44986's checks: 1 passed.
- On MI350X, `test_kimi_k3_route_sort.py` with the existing layer-boundary tests `test_kimi_k3_stage_kernels.py` and
  `test_attn_bank_residual_ops.py`: 11 passed, 7 failed (23 subtests passed). All 7 failures are in
  `test/registered/unit/layer_boundary/test_attn_bank_residual_ops.py`, which fails the same 7 tests on unmodified
  `main` on this pod (`'_Norm' object has no attribute 'weight'`), unchanged by this PR.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- Split front: front GEMM 8.8 vs 16.7 us at M = 4, gather 4.6 us at 4 rows; C1 decode cycle 17.25 -> 16.86 ms. SiTU in
  the gather: 16.63 -> 16.24 ms. Top-k in the gather: route sort on precomputed routes 3.1 / 4.4 / 9.2 us at 4 / 16 /
  64 tokens vs aiter moe_sorting ~9.
- Bank partials: C1 cycle -1.6%, C4 -0.6% (C16, 64 rows: +3%, hence <= 16 rows); isolated 8-GPU reads flat at
  8.3 us (gather) / 11.85 us (all-reduce) across nvb.

### End to end (queue checkpoints)

K3 server built from `main` 4eb606b2ae plus the queue up to each slot, with #43599's aux capture (and #41867 and
#41848 from slot 10 on, which apply only once #44987 is in); C1 decode on a 50K-token cached prefix (500 output tokens)
and GSM8K 200, EAGLE3 as above, measured 2026-10-17. These runs and the previous integration below also set `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_AUTO_KV_SPLITS=1 SGLANG_AITER_MLA_MAX_SPLITS_PER_BATCH=128 SGLANG_OPT_FUSED_KDA_VERIFY=1 AITER_MLA_REDUCE_FLYDSL=1`. In bold: the first checkpoint that includes this PR.

| Queue up to | Adds | C1 decode cycle | GSM8K 200 |
|---|---|---|---|
| slot 5 | #44978, #44979, #44980, #44981, #44982 | 21.6 ms\* | 0.995 |
| slot 7 | #44983, #44984 | 19.4 ms | 0.990 |
| slot 9 | #44985, #44986 | 18.6 ms | 0.990 |
| slot 10 | #44987, #41867, #41848 | 16.7 ms | 0.985 |
| **slot 11** | **#44988** | **15.7 ms** | **0.990** |
| slot 12 | #44989 | 15.6 ms | 0.990 |

\* The second of two runs; the first, right after start-up, measured 25.6 ms. The other rows average two runs.

The whole series, from the previous integration: the seven earlier drafts (#44547-#44553) merged on `main` b67785153a (this series'
code plus the two opt-in paths it drops, both off by default), with #43599's aux capture, #41867 and #41848; agentic
replay of lightseekorg/agentic-dataset SWE-smith conversations (multi-turn, ~50K-token cached prefixes, 500 output
tokens, greedy), EAGLE3 as above. TokenSpeed (7e2f1deb, same pod, same workload) for reference.

| Concurrency | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SGLang, tok/s/user | 217.2 | 156.6 | 114.1 | 73.4 | 43.4 |
| TokenSpeed, tok/s/user | 188.1 | 129.5 | 86.1 | 59.7 | 35.5 |

786/786 requests OK. GSM8K 400: 0.9825 / accept length 3.619. Decode cycle C1 / C4 / C16: 15.8 / 23.2 / 38.9 ms;
agentic turn TTFT (50K cached + 1.9K new tokens) 230-248 ms; uncached 50K-token prefill 3.27 s. The slot-12
checkpoint's C1 cycle (15.6 ms) is in line with it.

## Related

- The measurements above also had #41867 and #41848 applied.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -15,12 +15,19 @@
 import triton
 import triton.language as tl
 
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
+
 # _agg_kernel keeps a next_pow2(nvb) x next_pow2(H) fp32 tile in registers, and
 # that is the whole basis of its speed. Past this budget it spills and loses to
 # the 2-kernel Triton pipeline it replaces: measured at T=4 on MI355X,
 # next_pow2(nvb)=8 is 2.0x faster, 16 is 1.2x, 32 is 0.2x. K3 sits right at the
 # limit with H=7168 (one masked tile of 8192) and nvb <= 8.
 MAX_REGISTER_TILE: int = 8 * 8192
+# On gfx950, batches of at least STREAM_MIN_ROWS whose bank tile pads to 8 rows read
+# the bank two rows at a time instead (_agg_stream_kernel): many CTAs per CU then beat
+# one register-bound CTA. Measured on MI350X; at 4 rows the register tile still wins.
+STREAM_MIN_ROWS: int = 64
+STREAM_MIN_TILE_ROWS: int = 8
 
 
 @cache
@@ -133,6 +140,84 @@ def _agg_kernel(
     tl.store(out_ptr + t * stride_o + offs, acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
 
 
+@triton.jit
+def _agg_stream_kernel(
+    prefix_ptr,  # [T, H]
+    addend_ptr,  # [T, H]; the pending residual, or prefix_ptr when not HAS_ADD
+    prefix_out_ptr,  # [T, H]; materialized prefix, written when HAS_ADD
+    bank_ptr,  # [T, NB, H]
+    cw_ptr,  # [H] fp32; score_norm weight * score_proj weight
+    ow_ptr,  # [H]; out RMSNorm weight, unread when not APPLY_OUT_NORM
+    out_ptr,  # [T, H]
+    score_eps,
+    out_eps,
+    nvb,
+    stride_pm,
+    stride_am,
+    stride_om,
+    stride_bm,
+    stride_bb,
+    stride_o,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_ADD: tl.constexpr,
+    WRITE_BANK: tl.constexpr,
+    APPLY_OUT_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """_agg_kernel for prefill-sized batches: the bank is read ROWS rows at a time
+    (a runtime loop with an online softmax), so a CTA holds a bounded tile instead
+    of the whole bank and enough CTAs share a CU to stream at HBM bandwidth. Same
+    math as _agg_kernel; the running rescale rounds differently in the last ulp."""
+    t = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    mask = offs < H
+
+    row = tl.load(prefix_ptr + t * stride_pm + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    if HAS_ADD:
+        row = (
+            row.to(tl.float32)
+            + tl.load(addend_ptr + t * stride_am + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(
+                tl.float32
+            )
+        ).to(prefix_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
+        tl.store(prefix_out_ptr + t * stride_om + offs, row, mask=mask)
+    if WRITE_BANK:
+        tl.store(bank_ptr + t * stride_bm + nvb * stride_bb + offs, row, mask=mask)
+    acc = row.to(tl.float32)
+
+    cw = tl.load(cw_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    m = tl.sum(acc * cw) / tl.sqrt(tl.sum(acc * acc) / H + score_eps)
+    denom = 1.0
+    offs_r = tl.arange(0, ROWS)
+    for i in range(0, nvb, ROWS):
+        mask_r = (i + offs_r) < nvb
+        tile = tl.load(
+            bank_ptr
+            + t * stride_bm
+            + (i + offs_r)[:, None] * stride_bb
+            + offs[None, :],
+            mask=mask_r[:, None] & mask[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        score = tl.sum(tile * cw[None, :], axis=1) / tl.sqrt(
+            tl.sum(tile * tile, axis=1) / H + score_eps
+        )
+        m_new = tl.maximum(m, tl.max(tl.where(mask_r, score, -float("inf"))))
+        alpha = tl.exp(m - m_new)
+        w = tl.where(mask_r, tl.exp(score - m_new), 0.0)
+        denom = denom * alpha + tl.sum(w)
+        acc = acc * alpha + tl.sum(w[:, None] * tile, axis=0)
+        m = m_new
+    acc = acc / denom
+
+    if APPLY_OUT_NORM:
+        scale = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(tl.sum(acc * acc) / H + out_eps)
+        ow = tl.load(ow_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        acc = acc * scale * ow
+    tl.store(out_ptr + t * stride_o + offs, acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+
+
 def attn_res_hip(
     prefix_sum: torch.Tensor,
     bank: torch.Tensor,
@@ -185,28 +270,45 @@ def attn_res_hip(
     prefix_out_arg = prefix_out if has_add else prefix_sum
     ow_arg = ow if ow is not None else cw
 
-    _agg_kernel[(T,)](
-        prefix_sum,

+    BT: tl.constexpr,
+    BV: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_XCDS: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_INITIAL_STATE: tl.constexpr,
+    IS_VARLEN: tl.constexpr,
+    TRACK_STATE: tl.constexpr,
+):

+            A, (BT, T), (1, H * BT), (0, i_t * BT), (BT, BT), (0, 1)

+    w: torch.Tensor,
+    u: torch.Tensor,
+    gk: torch.Tensor,

+        initial_state_indices=initial_state_indices,
+        stride_init_state=initial_state.stride(0),
+        cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,

+"""Kimi-K3 TP8 collectives fused with an attention-residual read on gfx950 (see
+csrc/kimi_k3/attn_res/read_hip.cuh), over communication/k3_ll_comm_hip's
+scratch: the all-gather of the next stream, whose every rank finishes one
+[T, H / 8] column slice in-kernel from the column-parallel latent-MoE tail's
+split-K partials; and the attention output's all-reduce with the residual
+add, ahead of the FFN-side read.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit
+from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.k3_ll_comm_hip import (
+    MAX_ROWS,
+    WORLD_SIZE,
+    LLComm,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+HIDDEN_SIZE: int = 7168
+SLICE_SIZE: int = HIDDEN_SIZE // WORLD_SIZE
+MAX_NVB: int = 8
+# Must match kTailK / kTailSplits in the kernel.
+TAIL_LATENT: int = 3584
+TAIL_SPLITS: int = 7
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _module() -> Module:
+    from aiter.jit.core import AITER_CSRC_DIR
+
+    return load_jit(
+        "kimi_k3_attn_res_read",
+        cuda_files=["kimi_k3/attn_res/read_hip.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[
+            ("run", "k3_attn_res_read::K3AttnResReadKernel::run"),
+            ("ar_run", "k3_attn_res_read::K3AttnResArReadKernel::run"),
+        ],
+        # AITER's CustomAllreduce, whose meta buffers hold the all-gather scratch
+        extra_include_paths=[f"{AITER_CSRC_DIR}/include"],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"],
+    )
+
+
+def gather_shape_covered(
+    rows: int, slice_width: int, bank: torch.Tensor, nvb: int, write: bool = False
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether the gather reads take [rows, slice_width] slices of bank's stream."""
+    return (
+        0 < rows <= MAX_ROWS
+        and slice_width == SLICE_SIZE
+        and 1 <= nvb <= MAX_NVB
+        and bank.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and bank.dim() == 3
+        and bank.shape[0] == rows
+        and bank.shape[2] == HIDDEN_SIZE
+        and bank.stride(-1) == 1
+        and bank.stride(0) % 8 == 0
+        and bank.stride(1) % 8 == 0
+        and (not write or nvb < bank.shape[1])
+    )
+
+
+def tail_covered(shared: torch.Tensor, prefix: Optional[torch.Tensor]) -> bool:
+    """Whether gather_tail_attn_res_read takes the tail's shared output and prefix."""
+    return (
+        shared.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and shared.shape[1] == HIDDEN_SIZE
+        and shared.stride(1) == 1
+        and shared.stride(0) % 8 == 0
+        and shared.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+        and (
+            prefix is None
+            or (
+                prefix.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+                and prefix.shape == shared.shape
+                and prefix.stride() == shared.stride()
+                and prefix.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+            )
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _partial_args(bank_partial, rows, placeholder):
+    """(acc, ms, given) kernel args of a read's bank partials ([T, H], [T, 2] fp32)."""
+    if bank_partial is None:
+        return placeholder, placeholder, False
+    acc, ms = bank_partial
+    return acc[:rows], ms[:rows], True
+
+
+def gather_tail_attn_res_read(
+    part: torch.Tensor,
+    sq: torch.Tensor,
+    shared: torch.Tensor,
+    prefix: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    tail_eps: float,
+    bank: torch.Tensor,
+    nvb: int,
+    cw: torch.Tensor,
+    ow: torch.Tensor,
+    score_eps: float,
+    out_eps: float,
+    comm: LLComm,
+    *,
+    write_bank: bool = False,
+    bank_partial: Optional[tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """(rmsnorm(mix(bank[:, :nvb], stream)) * ow, stream) with stream the
+    all-gather of every rank's [T, H / 8] column slice (rank r holds columns
+    [r * H / 8, (r + 1) * H / 8)), finished from the column tail's partials
+    (k3_latent_tail_partials of its up_proj rows):
+    bf16(bf16(sum_k part[k] / rms) + shared[:, cols] [+ prefix[:, cols]]).
+    cw and ow are fp32 [H]; write_bank also stores the stream into bank[:, nvb].
+    bank_partial: (acc, ms), bank[:, :nvb]'s softmax partials for cw computed
+    ahead (kimi_k3_route_sort.BankPartials), read instead of the bank."""
+    rows = bank.shape[0]
+    stream = bank.new_empty((rows, HIDDEN_SIZE))
+    out = bank.new_empty((rows, HIDDEN_SIZE))
+    acc, ms, partial_given = _partial_args(bank_partial, rows, cw)
+    _module().run(
+        comm.comm._ptr,
+        prefix if prefix is not None else shared,
+        bank,
+        cw,
+        ow,
+        stream,
+        out,
+        comm.epochs,
+        part,
+        sq,
+        shared,
+        acc,
+        ms,
+        nvb,
+        prefix is not None,
+        write_bank,
+        partial_given,
+        float(score_eps),
+        float(out_eps),
+        float(tail_eps),
+    )
+    return out, stream
+
+
+# Measured in-server on MI350X: faster than aiter's all-reduce + the Triton read only at
+# 4 rows (EAGLE C1 verify).
+AR_READ_ROWS: tuple[int, ...] = (4,)
+
+
+def all_reduce_covered(
+    partial: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    bank: torch.Tensor,
+    nvb: int,
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether all_reduce_attn_res_read takes the attention output's partial."""
+
+    def dense_rows(x):
+        return (
+            x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and x.shape == (bank.shape[0], HIDDEN_SIZE)
+            and x.is_contiguous()
+            and x.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+        )
+
+    return (
+        partial.shape[0] in AR_READ_ROWS
+        and dense_rows(partial)
+        and (residual is None or dense_rows(residual))
+        and gather_shape_covered(partial.shape[0], SLICE_SIZE, bank, nvb)
+    )
+
+
+def all_reduce_attn_res_read(
+    partial: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    bank: torch.Tensor,
+    nvb: int,
+    cw: torch.Tensor,
+    ow: torch.Tensor,
+    score_eps: float,
+    out_eps: float,
+    comm: LLComm,
+    bank_partial: Optional[tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """(rmsnorm(mix(bank[:, :nvb], stream)) * ow, stream) with stream =
+    bf16(residual + all-reduce(partial)) over TP8 (residual None: the sum
+    alone); partial and residual are [T, H] bf16, cw and ow fp32 [H]. The
+    caller checked all_reduce_covered(). bank_partial as in
+    gather_tail_attn_res_read."""
+    rows = partial.shape[0]
+    stream = partial.new_empty((rows, HIDDEN_SIZE))
+    out = partial.new_empty((rows, HIDDEN_SIZE))
+    acc, ms, partial_given = _partial_args(bank_partial, rows, cw)
+    _module().ar_run(
+        comm.comm._ptr,
+        partial,
+        residual if residual is not None else partial,
+        bank,
+        cw,
+        ow,
+        stream,
+        out,
+        comm.ar_epochs,
+        comm.ar_pushed,
+        acc,
+        ms,
+        nvb,
+        residual is not None,
+        partial_given,
+        float(score_eps),
+        float(out_eps),
+    )
+    return out, stream

+"""Absorbed MLA cached extend over an FP8 latent cache (gfx950).
+
+A short extend after a long cached prefix attends the paged latent cache
+directly with absorbed queries ``[T, H, kv_lora_rank + rope]`` instead of
+expanding every prefix token to per-head K/V through kv_b_proj. Both costs grow
+with the prefix and this one also with the new tokens, so it serves only short
+extends (SGLANG_ROCM_MLA_ABSORBED_EXTEND_MAX_TOKENS). Each program packs BLOCK_Q
+query positions times BLOCK_H heads into the MFMA M dimension so one KV tile
+feeds all of them, over one split of the keys; a second kernel combines the
+splits by their LSE.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+# BLOCK_Q x BLOCK_H = 64 rows keep the [64, 512] fp32 accumulator in registers on gfx950 at
+# 4 warps (402 VGPRs incl. AGPRs, no spills); 128 rows spill. Measured at a 50K prefix.
+_BLOCK_Q = 4
+_BLOCK_H = 16
+# One program covers every head of its query block.
+MAX_HEADS = _BLOCK_H
+_BLOCK_N = 32
+# Programs to aim for across the batch, and the minimum keys per split.
+_TARGET_PROGRAMS = 512
+_MIN_SPLIT_KEYS = 512
+_MAX_SPLITS = 64
+
+
+class AbsorbedExtendPlan(NamedTuple):
+    """Per-batch work list: the request and first query of each BLOCK_Q block."""
+
+    block_req: torch.Tensor
+    block_q0: torch.Tensor
+    num_splits: int
+    total_q: int
+
+
+def plan_absorbed_extend(
+    extend_lens_cpu, kv_lens_cpu, device: torch.device
+) -> AbsorbedExtendPlan:
+    """The work list of mla_absorbed_extend from the per-request host lengths."""
+    reqs, q0s = [], []
+    for b, q_len in enumerate(extend_lens_cpu):
+        for q0 in range(0, int(q_len), _BLOCK_Q):
+            reqs.append(b)
+            q0s.append(q0)
+    max_kv = max(int(k) for k in kv_lens_cpu)
+    num_splits = max(
+        1,
+        min(
+            _MAX_SPLITS,
+            _TARGET_PROGRAMS // max(len(reqs), 1),
+            triton.cdiv(max_kv, _MIN_SPLIT_KEYS),
+        ),
+    )
+    work = torch.tensor([reqs, q0s], dtype=torch.int32).to(device, non_blocking=True)
+    return AbsorbedExtendPlan(
+        work[0], work[1], num_splits, int(sum(int(x) for x in extend_lens_cpu))
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _absorbed_extend_kernel(
+    Q,
+    KV,
+    KV_INDICES,
+    KV_INDPTR,
+    QO_INDPTR,
+    BLOCK_REQ,
+    BLOCK_Q0,
+    PART_O,
+    PART_LSE,
+    sm_scale,
+    kv_scale,
+    stride_qt,
+    stride_qh,
+    stride_kv,
+    stride_ps,
+    stride_pt,
+    stride_ph,
+    stride_ls,
+    stride_lt,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    LATENT: tl.constexpr,
+    ROPE: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_SPLITS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_Q: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    sid = tl.program_id(1)
+    b = tl.load(BLOCK_REQ + pid)
+    q0 = tl.load(BLOCK_Q0 + pid)
+    qo_start = tl.load(QO_INDPTR + b)
+    q_len = tl.load(QO_INDPTR + b + 1) - qo_start
+    kv_start = tl.load(KV_INDPTR + b)
+    prefix = tl.load(KV_INDPTR + b + 1) - kv_start - q_len
+
+    M: tl.constexpr = BLOCK_Q * BLOCK_H
+    rows = tl.arange(0, M)
+    qi = q0 + rows // BLOCK_H
+    hh = rows % BLOCK_H
+    row_ok = (qi < q_len) & (hh < H)
+    qpos = prefix + qi
+    # This block's queries see keys [0, kv_hi); this program takes one split.
+    kv_hi = prefix + tl.minimum(q0 + BLOCK_Q, q_len)
+    split = tl.cdiv(tl.cdiv(kv_hi, NUM_SPLITS), BLOCK_N) * BLOCK_N
+    lo = sid * split
+    hi = tl.minimum(lo + split, kv_hi)
+
+    offs_l = tl.arange(0, LATENT)
+    offs_r = tl.arange(0, ROPE)
+    offs_n = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    q_row = (
+        Q + (qo_start + qi).to(tl.int64)[:, None] * stride_qt + hh[:, None] * stride_qh
+    )
+    q_nope = tl.load(q_row + offs_l[None, :], mask=row_ok[:, None], other=0.0)
+    q_rope = tl.load(q_row + LATENT + offs_r[None, :], mask=row_ok[:, None], other=0.0)
+
+    m_i = tl.full([M], float("-inf"), tl.float32)
+    l_i = tl.zeros([M], tl.float32)
+    acc = tl.zeros([M, LATENT], tl.float32)
+    for start in range(lo, hi, BLOCK_N):
+        k_ok = start + offs_n < hi
+        idx = tl.load(KV_INDICES + kv_start + start + offs_n, mask=k_ok, other=0)
+        k_row = KV + idx.to(tl.int64)[:, None] * stride_kv
+        k_nope = tl.load(k_row + offs_l[None, :], mask=k_ok[:, None], other=0.0)
+        k_rope = tl.load(
+            k_row + LATENT + offs_r[None, :], mask=k_ok[:, None], other=0.0
+        )
+        s = tl.dot(q_nope, tl.trans(k_nope)) + tl.dot(q_rope, tl.trans(k_rope))
+        s = s * (sm_scale * kv_scale)
+        seen = (start + offs_n)[None, :] <= qpos[:, None]
+        s = tl.where(seen & k_ok[None, :], s, float("-inf"))
+        m_new = tl.maximum(m_i, tl.max(s, 1))
+        # Rows that have seen no key yet keep m = -inf; shift by 0 there.
+        m_safe = tl.where(m_new == float("-inf"), 0.0, m_new)
+        alpha = tl.exp(m_i - m_safe)
+        p = tl.exp(s - m_safe[:, None])
+        l_i = l_i * alpha + tl.sum(p, 1)
+        acc = acc * alpha[:, None] + tl.dot(p.to(tl.bfloat16), k_nope.to(tl.bfloat16))
+        m_i = m_new
+
+    has = l_i > 0.0
+    out = acc * (kv_scale / tl.where(has, l_i, 1.0))[:, None]
+    lse = tl.where(has, m_i + tl.log(tl.where(has, l_i, 1.0)), float("-inf"))
+    t = (qo_start + qi).to(tl.int64)
+    po = PART_O + sid * stride_ps + t[:, None] * stride_pt + hh[:, None] * stride_ph
+    tl.store(po + offs_l[None, :], out, mask=row_ok[:, None])
+    tl.store(PART_LSE + sid * stride_ls + t * stride_lt + hh, lse, mask=row_ok)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _combine_kernel(
+    PART_O,
+    PART_LSE,
+    O,
+    stride_ps,
+    stride_pt,
+    stride_ph,
+    stride_ls,
+    stride_lt,
+    stride_ot,
+    stride_oh,
+    NUM_SPLITS: tl.constexpr,
+    SPLITS_P2: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_L: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    t = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    h = tl.program_id(1)
+    offs_l = tl.program_id(2) * BLOCK_L + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_L)
+    offs_s = tl.arange(0, SPLITS_P2)
+    lse = tl.load(
+        PART_LSE + offs_s * stride_ls + t * stride_lt + h,
+        mask=offs_s < NUM_SPLITS,
+        other=float("-inf"),
+    )
+    w = tl.exp(lse - tl.max(lse, 0))
+    w = w / tl.sum(w, 0)
+    part = tl.load(
+        PART_O
+        + offs_s[:, None] * stride_ps
+        + t * stride_pt
+        + h * stride_ph
+        + offs_l[None, :],
+        mask=(w > 0.0)[:, None],
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    acc = tl.sum(part * w[:, None], 0)
+    tl.store(O + t * stride_ot + h * stride_oh + offs_l, acc.to(O.dtype.element_ty))
+
+
+def mla_absorbed_extend(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_indptr: torch.Tensor,
+    qo_indptr: torch.Tensor,
+    plan: AbsorbedExtendPlan,
+    sm_scale: float,
+    kv_lora_rank: int,
+    kv_scale: float = 1.0,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """o [T, H, kv_lora_rank] (bf16) for absorbed q [T, H, kv_lora_rank + rope]
+    (fp8 e4m3, unit scale) over kv_cache [slots, kv_lora_rank + rope] (fp8 e4m3
+    times kv_scale) whose kv_indices segments (kv_indptr) hold each request's
+    prefix and then its extend tokens; causal on global positions. H <= MAX_HEADS."""
+    total_q, num_heads, head_dim = q.shape
+    rope = head_dim - kv_lora_rank
+    splits = plan.num_splits
+    part_o = q.new_empty(
+        (splits, total_q, num_heads, kv_lora_rank), dtype=torch.float32
+    )
+    part_lse = q.new_empty((splits, total_q, num_heads), dtype=torch.float32)
+    _absorbed_extend_kernel[(plan.block_req.numel(), splits)](
+        q,
+        kv_cache,
+        kv_indices,
+        kv_indptr,
+        qo_indptr,
+        plan.block_req,
+        plan.block_q0,
+        part_o,
+        part_lse,
+        sm_scale,
+        kv_scale,
+        q.stride(0),
+        q.stride(1),
+        kv_cache.stride(0),
+        part_o.stride(0),
+        part_o.stride(1),
+        part_o.stride(2),
+        part_lse.stride(0),
+        part_lse.stride(1),
+        H=num_heads,
+        LATENT=kv_lora_rank,
+        ROPE=rope,
+        NUM_SPLITS=splits,
+        BLOCK_Q=_BLOCK_Q,
+        BLOCK_H=_BLOCK_H,
+        BLOCK_N=_BLOCK_N,
+        num_warps=4,
+        num_stages=2,
+    )
+    o = q.new_empty((total_q, num_heads, kv_lora_rank), dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    block_l = 128
+    _combine_kernel[(total_q, num_heads, kv_lora_rank // block_l)](
+        part_o,
+        part_lse,
+        o,
+        part_o.stride(0),
+        part_o.stride(1),
+        part_o.stride(2),
+        part_lse.stride(0),
+        part_lse.stride(1),
+        o.stride(0),
+        o.stride(1),
+        NUM_SPLITS=splits,
+        SPLITS_P2=triton.next_power_of_2(splits),
+        BLOCK_L=block_l,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+    return o

+
+For aiter's persistent MLA decode stage 1 (head-padded, split KV), one program per

+through W_vc and applies Kimi-K3's output gate:
+    attn[t, h] = bf16(sum_j exp(lse_j - lse) * partial_j[t, h])   rows a reduce
+                 tile covers; else stage 1's own output o[t, h]
+    out[t, h]  = bf16(bf16(attn[t, h] @ w_vc[h]) [* bf16(sigmoid(gate[t, h]))])
+with the rounding points of mla_split_reduce + mla_v_up_gate (the split
+summation order differs). A 16-wave program loads every split of its row in
+one [splits, latent] tile, so no latent intermediate is written or reread.
+
+Partial layout (aiter mla_decode_fwd, persistent mode):
+    partial_output [P * max_q, 1, HP, L] fp32,  partial_lse [P * max_q, 1, HP, 1] fp32
+For reduce tile i the splits are reduce_partial_map[reduce_indptr[i]:reduce_indptr[i+1]];
+row l of the tile (final row reduce_final_map[i][0] + l) reads partial row map + l.
+"""
+

+
+import functools
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+# Splits one program combines in a single tile (SGLANG_AITER_MLA_MAX_SPLITS_PER_BATCH=128).
+MAX_SPLITS: int = 128
+MIN_ROWS: int = 1
+MAX_ROWS: int = 64
+
+

+def _global_lse(max_lse, sum_lse):
+    # aiter's guard: an empty or NaN sum gives +inf, which zeroes the row.
+    return tl.where(
+        (sum_lse == 0.0) | (sum_lse != sum_lse), float("inf"), tl.log(sum_lse) + max_lse
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mla_decode_epilogue_kernel(
+    partial_out_ptr,
+    partial_lse_ptr,
+    reduce_indptr_ptr,
+    reduce_final_map_ptr,
+    reduce_partial_map_ptr,
+    num_tiles,
+    o_ptr,  # [S, HP, L]: stage 1's output for rows no reduce tile covers
+    stride_os,
+    stride_oh,
+    w_ptr,  # [H, L, V]
+    stride_wh,
+    stride_wl,
+    stride_wv,
+    gate_ptr,  # [S, H * V]
+    stride_gt,
+    out_ptr,  # [S, H * V]
+    stride_ot,
+    HP: tl.constexpr,
+    L: tl.constexpr,
+    V: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_S: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_TILES: tl.constexpr,

+        BLOCK_V=V // v_split,
+        HAS_GATE=gate is not None,

+"""Fused MLA decode/verify query+key prep for aiter's head-padded asm kernel.
+
+One launch for what the absorbed-MLA path otherwise runs as seven small ops:
+    q_pad[t, h] = cat(q_nope[t, h], q_rope[t, h]) for h < H, zeros for H <= h < Hp
+    kv[loc[t]]  = fp8(cat(k_nope[t], k_rope[t]))   (zeros when loc[t] == 0)
+    kv[0]       = 0
+Row 0 is where CUDA-graph padding tokens write their KV, and the asm kernel
+reads it (weighted by p = 0) for masked positions, so it must stay finite.
+The fp8 write is a plain cast, as MLATokenToKVPool.set_kv_buffer does.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mla_qk_prep_kernel(
+    q_nope_ptr,
+    q_rope_ptr,
+    k_nope_ptr,
+    k_rope_ptr,
+    loc_ptr,
+    kv_ptr,
+    q_out_ptr,
+    stride_qn_t,
+    stride_qn_h,
+    stride_qr_t,
+    stride_qr_h,
+    stride_kn_t,
+    stride_kr_t,
+    stride_kv_row,
+    stride_qo_t,
+    stride_qo_h,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    HP: tl.constexpr,
+    DN: tl.constexpr,
+    DR: tl.constexpr,
+    Q_FP8: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    t = tl.program_id(0)
+    h = tl.program_id(1)
+    offs_n = tl.arange(0, DN)
+    offs_r = tl.arange(0, DR)
+    dst = q_out_ptr + t * stride_qo_t + h * stride_qo_h
+    if h < H:
+        qn = tl.load(q_nope_ptr + t * stride_qn_t + h * stride_qn_h + offs_n)
+        qr = tl.load(q_rope_ptr + t * stride_qr_t + h * stride_qr_h + offs_r)
+        if Q_FP8:
+            # Unit-scale e4m3 query, saturated rather than overflowing to NaN.
+            qn = tl.clamp(qn.to(tl.float32), -448.0, 448.0)
+            qr = tl.clamp(qr.to(tl.float32), -448.0, 448.0)
+        tl.store(dst + offs_n, qn.to(q_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty))
+        tl.store(dst + DN + offs_r, qr.to(q_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty))
+    else:
+        tl.store(dst + offs_n, tl.zeros([DN], dtype=q_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty))
+        tl.store(dst + DN + offs_r, tl.zeros([DR], dtype=q_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty))
+
+    if h == 0:
+        loc = tl.load(loc_ptr + t)
+        keep = loc != 0
+        kn = tl.load(k_nope_ptr + t * stride_kn_t + offs_n).to(tl.float32)
+        kr = tl.load(k_rope_ptr + t * stride_kr_t + offs_r).to(tl.float32)
+        kn = tl.where(keep, kn, 0.0)
+        kr = tl.where(keep, kr, 0.0)
+        row = kv_ptr + loc * stride_kv_row
+        tl.store(row + offs_n, kn.to(kv_ptr.dtype.element_ty))
+        tl.store(row + DN + offs_r, kr.to(kv_ptr.dtype.element_ty))
+    if t == 0 and h == HP - 1:
+        # Same zeros a padding token (loc 0) writes, so the overlap is benign.
+        tl.store(kv_ptr + offs_n, tl.zeros([DN], dtype=kv_ptr.dtype.element_ty))
+        tl.store(kv_ptr + DN + offs_r, tl.zeros([DR], dtype=kv_ptr.dtype.element_ty))
+
+
+def mla_qk_prep(
+    q_nope: torch.Tensor,
+    q_rope: torch.Tensor,
+    k_nope: torch.Tensor,
+    k_rope: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_loc: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_buffer: torch.Tensor,
+    num_head_padded: int,
+    q_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """q_nope [T, H, Dn], q_rope [T, H, Dr], k_nope / k_rope [T, (1,) Dn / Dr]
+    (any row/head strides, unit inner stride), cache_loc [T], kv_buffer
+    [S, 1, Dn + Dr] fp8. Writes the KV rows and returns q_pad [T, Hp, Dn + Dr]
+    in q_dtype (default q_nope's; float8_e4m3fn gives a unit-scale fp8 query)."""
+    T, H, DN = q_nope.shape
+    DR = q_rope.shape[-1]
+    assert q_rope.shape[:2] == (T, H) and kv_buffer.shape[-1] == DN + DR
+    assert k_nope.shape[-1] == DN and k_rope.shape[-1] == DR
+    assert kv_buffer.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn, "the KV write is a plain fp8 cast"

+        (T, num_head_padded, DN + DR), dtype=q_dtype or q_nope.dtype
+    )

+    kv = kv_buffer.view(kv_buffer.shape[0], -1)
+    k_nope2 = k_nope.squeeze(1) if k_nope.dim() == 3 else k_nope
+    k_rope2 = k_rope.squeeze(1) if k_rope.dim() == 3 else k_rope
+    _mla_qk_prep_kernel[(T, num_head_padded)](
+        q_nope,
+        q_rope,
+        k_nope2,
+        k_rope2,
+        cache_loc,
+        kv,
+        q_pad,
+        q_nope.stride(0),
+        q_nope.stride(1),
+        q_rope.stride(0),
+        q_rope.stride(1),
+        k_nope2.stride(0),
+        k_rope2.stride(0),
+        kv.stride(0),
+        q_pad.stride(0),
+        q_pad.stride(1),
+        H=H,
+        HP=num_head_padded,
+        DN=DN,
+        DR=DR,
+        Q_FP8=q_pad.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+        num_warps=2,
+    )
+    return q_pad

+"""MLA cached-prefix K/V expansion for an FP8 prefill kernel, in two launches.
+
+An extend over a cached prefix re-expands the whole latent cache:
+    gather:  kvc = bf16(cache[idx, :R]), k_pe = cache[idx, R:]     (fp8 cache)
+    kv_b_proj GEMM on kvc  -> kv [L, H, Dn + Dv]
+    pack:    k = fp8(cat(kv[:, h, :Dn], k_pe)), v = fp8(kv[:, h, Dn:])
+             for output heads h' = 0 .. Hp - 1 tiled from h = h' % H
+replacing index_select, two casts, a contiguous copy, the k_pe cat, the head
+repeat and two fp8 casts. The casts are plain round-to-nearest conversions, as
+torch's .to(float8_e4m3fn) does for in-range values; k_pe keeps its cached bytes.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _gather_latent_kernel(
+    cache_ptr,  # [slots, R + P] fp8 rows
+    idx_ptr,  # [L]
+    kvc_ptr,  # [L, R] bf16
+    pe_ptr,  # [L, P] fp8
+    L,
+    stride_cache,
+    R: tl.constexpr,
+    P: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_L: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    rows = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK_L + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_L)
+    row_mask = rows < L
+    src = tl.load(idx_ptr + rows, mask=row_mask, other=0).to(tl.int64)
+    o_r = tl.arange(0, R)
+    lat = tl.load(
+        cache_ptr + src[:, None] * stride_cache + o_r[None, :],
+        mask=row_mask[:, None],
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        kvc_ptr + rows[:, None].to(tl.int64) * R + o_r[None, :],
+        lat.to(kvc_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        mask=row_mask[:, None],
+    )
+    o_p = tl.arange(0, P)
+    pe = tl.load(
+        cache_ptr + src[:, None] * stride_cache + R + o_p[None, :],
+        mask=row_mask[:, None],
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        pe_ptr + rows[:, None].to(tl.int64) * P + o_p[None, :],
+        pe,
+        mask=row_mask[:, None],
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pack_kv_kernel(
+    kv_ptr,  # [L, H, DN + DV] bf16, row stride stride_kv
+    pe_ptr,  # [L, P] fp8
+    k_ptr,  # [L, HP, DN + P] fp8
+    v_ptr,  # [L, HP, DV] fp8
+    L,
+    stride_kv,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    HP: tl.constexpr,
+    DN: tl.constexpr,
+    DV: tl.constexpr,
+    P: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_L: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    h = tl.program_id(1)
+    rows = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK_L + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_L)
+    row_mask = rows[:, None] < L
+    rows64 = rows[:, None].to(tl.int64)
+    o_n = tl.arange(0, DN)
+    o_v = tl.arange(0, DV)
+    o_p = tl.arange(0, P)
+    src = kv_ptr + rows64 * stride_kv + h * (DN + DV)
+    k_nope = tl.load(src + o_n[None, :], mask=row_mask, other=0.0).to(
+        k_ptr.dtype.element_ty
+    )
+    v = tl.load(src + DN + o_v[None, :], mask=row_mask, other=0.0).to(
+        v_ptr.dtype.element_ty
+    )
+    pe = tl.load(pe_ptr + rows64 * P + o_p[None, :], mask=row_mask, other=0.0)
+    # Output head h, and h + H while it is a tiled padding head.
+    for rep in tl.static_range(0, HP, H):
+        if rep + h < HP:
+            k_row = k_ptr + (rows64 * HP + rep + h) * (DN + P)
+            tl.store(k_row + o_n[None, :], k_nope, mask=row_mask)
+            tl.store(k_row + DN + o_p[None, :], pe, mask=row_mask)
+            tl.store(
+                v_ptr + (rows64 * HP + rep + h) * DV + o_v[None, :], v, mask=row_mask
+            )
+
+
+def gather_prefix_latent(
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor, kv_indices: torch.Tensor, kv_lora_rank: int
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """kv_cache [slots, 1, R + P] fp8, kv_indices [L] -> (bf16 latent [L, R],
+    fp8 rope part [L, P])."""
+    cache = kv_cache.view(kv_cache.shape[0], -1)
+    width = cache.shape[1]
+    rope = width - kv_lora_rank
+    num_rows = kv_indices.shape[0]
+    kvc = torch.empty(
+        (num_rows, kv_lora_rank), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=kv_cache.device
+    )
+    pe = torch.empty((num_rows, rope), dtype=kv_cache.dtype, device=kv_cache.device)
+    if num_rows:
+        block_l = 16
+        _gather_latent_kernel[(triton.cdiv(num_rows, block_l),)](
+            cache,
+            kv_indices,
+            kvc,
+            pe,
+            num_rows,
+            cache.stride(0),
+            R=kv_lora_rank,
+            P=rope,
+            BLOCK_L=block_l,
+            num_warps=4,
+        )
+    return kvc, pe
+
+
+def pack_prefix_kv_fp8(
+    kv: torch.Tensor,
+    k_pe: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_heads_padded: int,
+    nope_dim: int,
+    v_dim: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """kv [L, H * (Dn + Dv)] bf16 (kv_b_proj output), k_pe [L, P] fp8 ->
+    (k [L, Hp, Dn + P], v [L, Hp, Dv]) in k_pe's fp8 dtype, heads tiled to Hp."""
+    num_rows = kv.shape[0]
+    rope = k_pe.shape[1]
+    assert kv.shape[1] == num_heads * (nope_dim + v_dim) and kv.stride(1) == 1
+    assert k_pe.is_contiguous() and num_heads_padded >= num_heads
+    k = torch.empty(
+        (num_rows, num_heads_padded, nope_dim + rope),
+        dtype=k_pe.dtype,
+        device=kv.device,
+    )
+    v = torch.empty(
+        (num_rows, num_heads_padded, v_dim), dtype=k_pe.dtype, device=kv.device
+    )
+    if num_rows:
+        block_l = 16
+        _pack_kv_kernel[(triton.cdiv(num_rows, block_l), num_heads)](
+            kv,
+            k_pe,
+            k,
+            v,
+            num_rows,
+            kv.stride(0),
+            H=num_heads,
+            HP=num_heads_padded,
+            DN=nope_dim,
+            DV=v_dim,
+            P=rope,
+            BLOCK_L=block_l,
+            num_warps=4,
+        )
+    return k, v

+Partial layout (aiter mla_decode_fwd, persistent mode):
+    partial_output [P * max_q, 1, HP, DV] fp32,  partial_lse [P * max_q, 1, HP, 1] fp32
+For reduce tile i the splits are reduce_partial_map[reduce_indptr[i]:reduce_indptr[i+1]];
+row l of the tile (final row reduce_final_map[i][0] + l) reads partial row map + l.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl

+
+@triton.jit
+def _global_lse(max_lse, sum_lse):
+    # aiter's guard: an empty or NaN sum gives +inf, which zeroes the row.
+    return tl.where(
+        (sum_lse == 0.0) | (sum_lse != sum_lse), float("inf"), tl.log(sum_lse) + max_lse
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mla_split_reduce_kernel(
+    partial_out_ptr,
+    partial_lse_ptr,
+    reduce_indptr_ptr,
+    reduce_final_map_ptr,
+    reduce_partial_map_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    stride_os,
+    stride_oh,
+    MAX_Q: tl.constexpr,
+    HP: tl.constexpr,
+    DV: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_S: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    head = tl.program_id(1)
+    d0 = tl.program_id(2) * BLOCK_D
+    tile = pid // MAX_Q
+    l = pid % MAX_Q
+
+    start = tl.load(reduce_indptr_ptr + tile)
+    n = tl.load(reduce_indptr_ptr + tile + 1) - start
+    q_start = tl.load(reduce_final_map_ptr + tile * 2)
+    q_end = tl.load(reduce_final_map_ptr + tile * 2 + 1)

+        return

+    offs_s = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_S)
+    offs_d = d0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
+    if n <= BLOCK_S:
+        # One chunk: every split's [BLOCK_D] slice in flight at once.
+        mask_s = offs_s < n
+        rows = (
+            tl.load(reduce_partial_map_ptr + start + offs_s, mask=mask_s, other=0) + l
+        )
+        lse = tl.load(
+            partial_lse_ptr + rows * HP + head, mask=mask_s, other=-float("inf")
+        )
+        max_lse = tl.max(lse, axis=0)
+        sum_lse = tl.sum(tl.where(mask_s, tl.exp(lse - max_lse), 0.0), axis=0)
+        global_lse = _global_lse(max_lse, sum_lse)
+        scale = tl.where(mask_s, tl.exp(lse - global_lse), 0.0)
+        part = tl.load(
+            partial_out_ptr + (rows[:, None] * HP + head) * DV + offs_d[None, :],
+            mask=mask_s[:, None],
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        acc = tl.sum(scale[:, None] * part, axis=0)
+    else:
+        # BLOCK_S chunks, two passes: the global LSE first, then the weighted sum.
+        max_lse = -float("inf")
+        for c0 in range(0, n, BLOCK_S):
+            mask_s = c0 + offs_s < n
+            rows = (
+                tl.load(
+                    reduce_partial_map_ptr + start + c0 + offs_s, mask=mask_s, other=0
+                )
+                + l
+            )
+            lse = tl.load(
+                partial_lse_ptr + rows * HP + head, mask=mask_s, other=-float("inf")
+            )
+            max_lse = tl.maximum(max_lse, tl.max(lse, axis=0))
+        sum_lse = 0.0
+        for c0 in range(0, n, BLOCK_S):
+            mask_s = c0 + offs_s < n
+            rows = (
+                tl.load(
+                    reduce_partial_map_ptr + start + c0 + offs_s, mask=mask_s, other=0
+                )
+                + l
+            )
+            lse = tl.load(
+                partial_lse_ptr + rows * HP + head, mask=mask_s, other=-float("inf")
+            )
+            sum_lse += tl.sum(tl.where(mask_s, tl.exp(lse - max_lse), 0.0), axis=0)
+        global_lse = _global_lse(max_lse, sum_lse)
+        acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_D], dtype=tl.float32)
+        for c0 in range(0, n, BLOCK_S):
+            mask_s = c0 + offs_s < n
+            rows = (
+                tl.load(
+                    reduce_partial_map_ptr + start + c0 + offs_s, mask=mask_s, other=0
+                )
+                + l
+            )
+            lse = tl.load(
+                partial_lse_ptr + rows * HP + head, mask=mask_s, other=-float("inf")
+            )
+            scale = tl.where(mask_s, tl.exp(lse - global_lse), 0.0)
+            part = tl.load(
+                partial_out_ptr + (rows[:, None] * HP + head) * DV + offs_d[None, :],
+                mask=mask_s[:, None],
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            acc += tl.sum(scale[:, None] * part, axis=0)
+
+    s = q_start + l
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + s * stride_os + head * stride_oh + offs_d,
+        acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+    )
+
+
+# One chunk covers SGLANG_AITER_MLA_MAX_SPLITS_PER_BATCH=128 splits; 64-wide
+# latent slices keep that [128, 64] fp32 tile at 32 registers per lane.
+_BLOCK_S = 128
+_BLOCK_D = 64
+
+# Above this many query rows aiter's reduce is faster (its one program per
+# (row, head) already fills the GPU). Measured on MI350X at 16 / 64 / 128 splits.
+MAX_ROWS: int = 16
+
+
+def mla_split_reduce(
+    partial_output: torch.Tensor,
+    partial_lse: torch.Tensor,
+    reduce_indptr: torch.Tensor,
+    reduce_final_map: torch.Tensor,
+    reduce_partial_map: torch.Tensor,
+    max_seqlen_q: int,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    num_heads: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Combine the split partials of the first num_heads heads into out
+    [S, HP, DV] (rows a reduce tile covers; other rows are left as stage 1
+    wrote them)."""
+    HP, DV = partial_output.shape[-2], partial_output.shape[-1]
+    num_tiles = reduce_indptr.shape[0] - 1
+    block_s, block_d = _BLOCK_S, _BLOCK_D
+    assert DV % block_d == 0 and out.stride(-1) == 1
+    assert reduce_final_map.is_contiguous() and reduce_final_map.shape[-1] == 2
+    _mla_split_reduce_kernel[(num_tiles * max_seqlen_q, num_heads, DV // block_d)](
+        partial_output,
+        partial_lse,
+        reduce_indptr,
+        reduce_final_map,
+        reduce_partial_map,
+        out,
+        out.stride(0),
+        out.stride(1),
+        MAX_Q=max_seqlen_q,
+        HP=HP,
+        DV=DV,
+        BLOCK_D=block_d,
+        BLOCK_S=block_s,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )

+"""Fused absorbed-MLA value up-projection + output gate for decode batches.
+
+One launch for the per-head bmm and Kimi-K3's output gate:
+    y[t, h] = bf16(attn[t, h] @ w_vc[h])                      # [T, H, V]
+    out     = bf16(y * bf16(sigmoid(gate)))                   # [T, H * V]
+with the rounding points of the unfused bmm + mla_output_gate pair. The bmm is
+tiny ([T, 512] x [512, 128] per head) and pure launch latency as a batched GEMM.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+MAX_TOKENS: int = 64
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mla_v_up_gate_kernel(
+    attn_ptr,  # [T, H, L]
+    w_ptr,  # [H, L, V]
+    gate_ptr,  # [T, H * V]
+    out_ptr,  # [T, H * V]
+    T,
+    stride_at,
+    stride_ah,
+    stride_wh,
+    stride_wl,
+    stride_wv,
+    stride_gt,
+    stride_ot,
+    L: tl.constexpr,
+    V: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_T: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_V: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_L: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_GATE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    h = tl.program_id(0)
+    v0 = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK_V
+    t0 = tl.program_id(2) * BLOCK_T
+    offs_t = t0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_T)
+    offs_v = v0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_V)
+    mask_t = offs_t < T
+
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_T, BLOCK_V], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for l0 in tl.range(0, L, BLOCK_L):
+        offs_l = l0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_L)
+        a = tl.load(
+            attn_ptr + offs_t[:, None] * stride_at + h * stride_ah + offs_l[None, :],
+            mask=mask_t[:, None],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.bfloat16)
+        w = tl.load(
+            w_ptr
+            + h * stride_wh
+            + offs_l[:, None] * stride_wl
+            + offs_v[None, :] * stride_wv
+        )
+        acc += tl.dot(a, w)
+
+    y = acc.to(tl.bfloat16)
+    cols = h * V + offs_v
+    if HAS_GATE:
+        g = tl.load(
+            gate_ptr + offs_t[:, None] * stride_gt + cols[None, :],
+            mask=mask_t[:, None],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        sig = (1.0 / (1.0 + tl.exp(-g))).to(tl.bfloat16)
+        y = (y.to(tl.float32) * sig.to(tl.float32)).to(tl.bfloat16)
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + offs_t[:, None] * stride_ot + cols[None, :], y, mask=mask_t[:, None]
+    )
+
+
+def covered(
+    attn: torch.Tensor, w_vc: torch.Tensor, gate: Optional[torch.Tensor]
+) -> bool:
+    T, H, L = attn.shape
+    return (
+        0 < T <= MAX_TOKENS
+        and w_vc.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and w_vc.dim() == 3
+        and w_vc.shape[0] == H
+        and w_vc.shape[1] == L
+        and attn.stride(-1) == 1
+        and triton.next_power_of_2(L) == L
+        and w_vc.shape[2] % 32 == 0
+        and (
+            gate is None
+            or (gate.shape == (T, H * w_vc.shape[2]) and gate.stride(-1) == 1)
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def mla_v_up_gate(
+    attn: torch.Tensor,
+    w_vc: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """attn [T, H, L] x w_vc [H, L, V] (any strides) -> [T, H * V] bf16, gated
+    by sigmoid(gate) [T, H * V] when given."""
+    T, H, L = attn.shape
+    V = w_vc.shape[2]
+    out = torch.empty((T, H * V), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=attn.device)
+    block_t = 16 if T <= 16 else 32
+    block_v = 32
+    gate_arg = gate if gate is not None else out
+    _mla_v_up_gate_kernel[(H, V // block_v, triton.cdiv(T, block_t))](
+        attn,
+        w_vc,
+        gate_arg,
+        out,
+        T,
+        attn.stride(0),
+        attn.stride(1),
+        w_vc.stride(0),
+        w_vc.stride(1),
+        w_vc.stride(2),
+        gate_arg.stride(0),
+        out.stride(0),
+        L=L,
+        V=V,
+        BLOCK_T=block_t,
+        BLOCK_V=block_v,
+        BLOCK_L=128,
+        HAS_GATE=gate is not None,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+    return out

+"""The communicator of Kimi-K3's TP8 LL collectives on gfx950 (csrc/kimi_k3/comm/ll_hip.cuh):
+the attention-residual read's stream gather and the attention output's all-reduce
+read (attention/k3_attn_res_read_hip), and the column-parallel MoE front's gather
+(moe/k3_front_gather_hip).
+
+Their scratch is the meta buffer tail of a dedicated aiter CustomAllreduce,
+which is never used for anything else: one region and one row of flags per
+collective.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from aiter.dist.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce import CustomAllreduce
+
+WORLD_SIZE: int = 8
+MAX_ROWS: int = 64
+# Per region: 2 epochs x world x rows x lines-per-row x 16 B (8 payload bytes a
+# line). The kernels hardcode the region order and line counts.
+_LINES_PER_ROW = (
+    2 * 7168 // WORLD_SIZE // 8,  # attention-residual read: an H / 8 bf16 slice
+    2 * 72,  # MoE front: [latent | logits] slices, padded to 72 vectors
+)
+# Then the all-reduce read's region: whole rows, two 16-byte lines per 8 bf16.
+AR_MAX_ROWS: int = 16
+_AR_LINES_PER_ROW = 2 * 7168 // 8
+_SCRATCH_BYTES: int = (
+    sum(2 * WORLD_SIZE * MAX_ROWS * n * 16 for n in _LINES_PER_ROW)
+    + 2 * WORLD_SIZE * AR_MAX_ROWS * _AR_LINES_PER_ROW * 16
+)
+
+
+class LLComm(NamedTuple):
+    comm: CustomAllreduce
+    # rank-local flags: [MAX_ROWS] attention-residual gather rows, then [MAX_ROWS] front rows
+    epochs: torch.Tensor
+    # rank-local, [AR_MAX_ROWS] each: the all-reduce read's row flags, and per row the
+    # count of this rank's pushers that took its flag (kept at 0 between launches)
+    ar_epochs: torch.Tensor
+    ar_pushed: torch.Tensor
+    # The attention-residual reads' bank partials, computed ahead of them (rank-local
+    # fp32): [2, MAX_ROWS, H] weighted sums and [2, MAX_ROWS, 2] (max, sum), one slot per
+    # read kind (attention side, FFN side).
+    bank_acc: torch.Tensor
+    bank_ms: torch.Tensor
+
+
+def create_ll_comm(cpu_group, device: torch.device) -> Optional[LLComm]:
+    """Collective over ``cpu_group`` (a non-NCCL group): every rank calls it,
+    outside graph capture."""
+    from aiter.dist.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce import CustomAllreduce
+
+    # aiter sizes the meta buffer as Signal + 2 * max_size.
+    comm = CustomAllreduce(cpu_group, device, max_size=(_SCRATCH_BYTES + 1) // 2)
+    if comm.disabled or comm.world_size != WORLD_SIZE:
+        return None
+    epochs = torch.zeros(2 * MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ar_epochs = torch.zeros(AR_MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ar_pushed = torch.zeros(AR_MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    bank_acc = torch.zeros(2, MAX_ROWS, 7168, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    bank_ms = torch.zeros(2, MAX_ROWS, 2, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    return LLComm(comm, epochs, ar_epochs, ar_pushed, bank_acc, bank_ms)

+"""Kimi-K3 latent-MoE input step in one Triton GEMM with the shared experts' SiTU in its epilogue.
+
+One launch over the merged front weight [shared gate | shared up | router | latent down] (rows).
+A gated tile pairs gate row j with up row N_HALF + j in adjacent columns, so it streams the same
+weight bytes as any other tile and writes SiTU(gate) * up; the rest write router logits and the
+latent input. Replaces the merged-front GEMM followed by a separate SiTU kernel for the prefill
+batch sizes covered() admits.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+# (first, last tokens, (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, BLOCK_K, GROUP_M, num_warps, num_stages, waves_per_eu)):
+# the sizes where it beats the tuned merged-front GEMM + SiTU kernel on MI350X, each with the
+# fastest config of a sweep; at the GEMM's tuned sizes and between these, the GEMM wins.
+_RANGES = (
+    (129, 160, (32, 128, 128, 8, 4, 3, 4)),
+    (193, 256, (128, 64, 128, 8, 4, 3, 1)),
+    (257, 320, (64, 128, 128, 8, 4, 3, 2)),
+    (1152, 1280, (256, 128, 64, 8, 8, 3, 1)),
+)
+
+
+def covered(num_tokens: int) -> bool:
+    return any(first <= num_tokens <= last for first, last, _ in _RANGES)
+
+
+def _config(num_tokens: int):
+    for first, last, config in _RANGES:
+        if first <= num_tokens <= last:
+            return config
+    raise ValueError(f"no front SiTU config for {num_tokens} tokens")
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _tanh(x):
+    return 2.0 / (1.0 + tl.exp(-2.0 * x)) - 1.0

+@triton.jit
+def _remap_xcd(pid, num_pids, NUM_XCDS: tl.constexpr):
+    # Hardware deals pids round-robin over the XCDs; give each XCD (one L2) a run of
+    # consecutive pids, so the programs that share a weight panel share its L2.
+    pids_per_xcd = (num_pids + NUM_XCDS - 1) // NUM_XCDS
+    tall_xcds = num_pids % NUM_XCDS

+    xcd = pid % NUM_XCDS
+    local_pid = pid // NUM_XCDS
+    return tl.where(
+        xcd < tall_xcds,
+        xcd * pids_per_xcd + local_pid,
+        tall_xcds * pids_per_xcd + (xcd - tall_xcds) * (pids_per_xcd - 1) + local_pid,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _grouped_pid(pid, num_pid_m, num_pid_n, GROUP_M: tl.constexpr):
+    if GROUP_M == 1:
+        pid_m = pid // num_pid_n
+        pid_n = pid % num_pid_n

+        num_pid_in_group = GROUP_M * num_pid_n

+        pid_m = first_pid_m + pid % group_size_m
+        pid_n = pid % num_pid_in_group // group_size_m
+    return pid_m, pid_n
+

+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    act_ptr,
+    rest_ptr,
+    M,
+    stride_xm,
+    stride_am,
+    stride_rm,
+    beta,
+    linear_beta,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    N_HALF: tl.constexpr,
+    N_REST: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    GROUP_M: tl.constexpr,

+"""Fused Kimi-K3 latent-MoE tail for small decode batches on gfx950.
+
+One launch for what the TP8 latent MoE otherwise runs as three (RMSNorm, the
+3584 -> 7168 up-projection, and the add3 with the shared-expert output and the
+residual prefix):
+    proj = bf16(inv_rms(latent) * (bf16(latent * norm_weight) @ up_weight.T))
+    out  = bf16(proj + shared [+ prefix])                         # fp32 add
+The per-row 1/rms commutes with the GEMM, so it is accumulated in the same pass
+over the latent and applied in the epilogue; the GEMM input is rounded to bf16
+before the row scale instead of after it, within bf16 noise of the unfused chain.
+
+Decode M is tiny, so this is a skinny GEMM bound by streaming up_weight once:
+each program owns BLOCK_N output columns for all M rows and walks K in full,
+with the weight tile as the MFMA A operand in its natural [N, K] layout.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+# Largest decode batch this path is tuned for; larger M keeps the unfused chain,
+# which is faster from M=48 on MI350X with HBM-streamed weights.
+MAX_TOKENS: int = 32
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _latent_tail_kernel(
+    latent_ptr,  # [M, L] bf16
+    norm_w_ptr,  # [L]
+    w_ptr,  # [H, L] bf16
+    shared_ptr,  # [M, H] bf16
+    prefix_ptr,  # [M, H] bf16
+    out_ptr,  # [M, H] bf16
+    M,
+    eps,
+    stride_lm,
+    stride_wn,
+    stride_sm,
+    stride_pm,
+    stride_om,
+    L: tl.constexpr,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_PREFIX: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid_n = tl.program_id(0)
+    offs_m = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    mask_m = offs_m < M
+    mask_n = offs_n < H
+
+    # acc[n, m] = sum_k W[n, k] * bf16(x[m, k] * nw[k]); sq[m] = sum_k x[m, k]^2
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_N, BLOCK_M], dtype=tl.float32)
+    sq = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for k0 in tl.range(0, L, BLOCK_K):
+        offs_k = k0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+        mask_k = offs_k < L
+        xt = tl.load(
+            latent_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_lm + offs_k[:, None],
+            mask=mask_m[None, :] & mask_k[:, None],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        nw = tl.load(norm_w_ptr + offs_k, mask=mask_k, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        # The weight is streamed once; skip L1 (".cg") so it does not evict x.
+        w = tl.load(
+            w_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * stride_wn + offs_k[None, :],
+            mask=mask_n[:, None] & mask_k[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+            cache_modifier=".cg",
+        )
+        sq += tl.sum(xt * xt, axis=0)
+        acc += tl.dot(w, (xt * nw[:, None]).to(tl.bfloat16))
+
+    inv_rms = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(sq / L + eps)
+    out = (acc * inv_rms[None, :]).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+    mask = mask_m[None, :] & mask_n[:, None]
+    out += tl.load(
+        shared_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_sm + offs_n[:, None], mask=mask, other=0.0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    if HAS_PREFIX:
+        out += tl.load(
+            prefix_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_pm + offs_n[:, None],
+            mask=mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_om + offs_n[:, None],
+        out.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        mask=mask,
+    )
+
+
+# The column-parallel tail's split of the latent dim: 3584 = 7 x 512, one chunk per program.
+PARTIAL_SPLITS: int = 7
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _latent_tail_partial_kernel(
+    latent_ptr,  # [M, L] bf16
+    norm_w_ptr,  # [L]
+    w_ptr,  # [N, L] bf16
+    part_ptr,  # [SPLITS, M, N] fp32
+    sq_ptr,  # [SPLITS, M] fp32
+    M,
+    stride_lm,
+    stride_wn,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """One K chunk of the tail's GEMM for BLOCK_N columns; programs of column
+    block 0 also store the chunk's sum of squares of the latent rows."""
+    pid_n = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_k = tl.program_id(1)
+    offs_m = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    offs_k = pid_k * BLOCK_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    mask_m = offs_m < M
+    xt = tl.load(
+        latent_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_lm + offs_k[:, None],
+        mask=mask_m[None, :],
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    nw = tl.load(norm_w_ptr + offs_k).to(tl.float32)
+    w = tl.load(
+        w_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * stride_wn + offs_k[None, :],
+        mask=(offs_n < N)[:, None],
+        other=0.0,
+        cache_modifier=".cg",
+    )
+    acc = tl.dot(w, (xt * nw[:, None]).to(tl.bfloat16))
+    tl.store(
+        part_ptr + (pid_k * M + offs_m[None, :]) * N + offs_n[:, None],
+        acc,
+        mask=mask_m[None, :] & (offs_n < N)[:, None],
+    )
+    if pid_n == 0:
+        tl.store(sq_ptr + pid_k * M + offs_m, tl.sum(xt * xt, axis=0), mask=mask_m)
+
+
+def k3_latent_tail_partials(
+    latent: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    up_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    # measured on MI350X (N = 896, HBM weights) against 16
+    block_n: int = 32,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """The tail GEMM of up_weight's [N, L] rows, split over L: per chunk k,
+    part[k] = bf16(latent * norm_weight)[:, chunk] @ up_weight[:, chunk].T
+    and sq[k] = sum(latent[:, chunk] ** 2). The consumer finishes the tail:
+    bf16(sum_k part / rms) + shared + prefix (see attention/k3_attn_res_read_hip)."""
+    M, L = latent.shape
+    N = up_weight.shape[0]
+    assert L % PARTIAL_SPLITS == 0
+    part = torch.empty(
+        (PARTIAL_SPLITS, M, N), dtype=torch.float32, device=latent.device
+    )
+    sq = torch.empty((PARTIAL_SPLITS, M), dtype=torch.float32, device=latent.device)
+    _latent_tail_partial_kernel[(triton.cdiv(N, block_n), PARTIAL_SPLITS)](
+        latent,
+        norm_weight,
+        up_weight,
+        part,
+        sq,
+        M,
+        latent.stride(0),
+        up_weight.stride(0),
+        N=N,
+        BLOCK_M=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(M)),
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        BLOCK_K=L // PARTIAL_SPLITS,
+        num_warps=4,
+        num_stages=1,
+        matrix_instr_nonkdim=16,
+    )
+    return part, sq
+
+
+def supports_latent_tail(
+    latent: torch.Tensor,
+    up_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    shared: torch.Tensor,
+    prefix: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+) -> bool:
+    return (
+        0 < latent.shape[0] <= MAX_TOKENS
+        and latent.dtype == up_weight.dtype == shared.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and latent.stride(-1) == 1
+        and up_weight.is_contiguous()
+        and shared.stride(-1) == 1
+        and (
+            prefix is None
+            or (prefix.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and prefix.stride(-1) == 1)
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def k3_latent_tail(
+    latent: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    up_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    shared: torch.Tensor,
+    prefix: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    *,
+    out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    block_n: int = 32,
+    block_k: int = 512,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """[prefix +] shared + rmsnorm(latent) @ up_weight.T for M <= MAX_TOKENS rows."""
+    M, L = latent.shape
+    H = up_weight.shape[0]
+    if out is None:
+        out = torch.empty((M, H), dtype=shared.dtype, device=latent.device)
+    # Measured on MI350X at the TP8 K3 shape (L=3584, H=7168), weights from HBM.
+    num_warps, waves_per_eu = (2, 2) if M == 1 else (4, 0)
+    _latent_tail_kernel[(triton.cdiv(H, block_n),)](
+        latent,
+        norm_weight,
+        up_weight,
+        shared,
+        shared if prefix is None else prefix,
+        out,
+        M,
+        eps,
+        latent.stride(0),
+        up_weight.stride(0),
+        shared.stride(0),
+        0 if prefix is None else prefix.stride(0),
+        out.stride(0),
+        L=L,
+        H=H,
+        BLOCK_M=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(M)),
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        BLOCK_K=block_k,
+        HAS_PREFIX=prefix is not None,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+        num_stages=3,
+        waves_per_eu=waves_per_eu,
+        matrix_instr_nonkdim=16,
+    )
+    return out

+"""Hands aiter's split-MLA stage-1 partials from the attention backend to the
+model's absorbed-V epilogue, which combines them together with W_vc and the
+output gate (kernels/ops/attention/mla_decode_epilogue.py) instead of the
+backend's own split reduce.
+
+The model opens a window around one attention call (``expecting``) only when
+its epilogue will run; the backend defers inside that window, and the
+epilogue takes the deferred reduce or finishes it the backend's way.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+from typing import Iterator, Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+
+class DeferredMlaReduce(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    # aiter persistent stage 1: [P * max_q, 1, HP, L] fp32 partials and their LSE.
+    partial_output: torch.Tensor
+    partial_lse: torch.Tensor
+    reduce_indptr: torch.Tensor
+    reduce_final_map: torch.Tensor
+    reduce_partial_map: torch.Tensor
+    max_q: int
+    # [S, HP, L]; the rows no reduce tile covers are already final.
+    o: torch.Tensor
+    num_heads: int
+    max_splits: int
+
+    def finish(self) -> None:
+        """The backend's own split reduce into o, for an epilogue that cannot
+        combine the partials itself."""
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention import mla_split_reduce
+
+        mla_split_reduce.mla_split_reduce(
+            self.partial_output,
+            self.partial_lse,
+            self.reduce_indptr,
+            self.reduce_final_map,
+            self.reduce_partial_map,
+            self.max_q,
+            self.o,
+            self.num_heads,
+        )
+
+
+class _Handoff(msgspec.Struct):
+    # the RadixAttention whose split reduce may be deferred, inside expecting()
+    expected: Optional[object] = None
+    pending: Optional[DeferredMlaReduce] = None
+
+
+_handoff = _Handoff()
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def expecting(layer: Optional[object]) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Let the attention call of ``layer`` (a RadixAttention, or None for no
+    deferral) defer its split reduce to the epilogue that follows it."""
+    _handoff.expected = layer
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        _handoff.expected = None
+        leftover, _handoff.pending = _handoff.pending, None
+    if leftover is not None:
+        raise RuntimeError("a deferred MLA split reduce was not taken by its epilogue")
+
+
+def defers(layer: object) -> bool:
+    return _handoff.expected is not None and layer is _handoff.expected
+
+
+def defer(reduce: DeferredMlaReduce) -> None:
+    assert _handoff.pending is None, "an MLA split reduce is already deferred"
+    _handoff.pending = reduce
+
+
+def take(attn_output: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[DeferredMlaReduce]:
+    """The deferred reduce whose output buffer attn_output views, or None."""
+    reduce = _handoff.pending
+    if reduce is None or reduce.o.data_ptr() != attn_output.data_ptr():
+        return None
+    _handoff.pending = None
+    return reduce

+"""The communicator of Kimi-K3's gfx950 TP8 LL collectives: the attention
+output's all-reduce fused with the FFN read (``SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FUSED_ATTN_AR_READ``),
+the column-parallel latent-MoE tail's gather fused with the next attention read
+(``SGLANG_ROCM_K3_COLUMN_TAIL``) and the column-parallel MoE front's gather
+(``SGLANG_ROCM_K3_SPLIT_FRONT``).
+
+``get_comm()`` is a collective over the TP group on its first call, so the
+model makes it at construction, where every rank builds the same layers in the
+same order and nothing is captured.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.k3_ll_comm_hip import LLComm
+
+
+@cache_once
+def get_comm() -> Optional[LLComm]:
+    if not is_gfx95_supported() or not (
+        envs.SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FUSED_ATTN_AR_READ.get()
+        or envs.SGLANG_ROCM_K3_COLUMN_TAIL.get()
+        or envs.SGLANG_ROCM_K3_SPLIT_FRONT.get()
+    ):
+        return None
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.k3_ll_comm_hip import (
+        WORLD_SIZE,
+        create_ll_comm,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+    parallel = get_parallel()
+    if parallel.tp_size != WORLD_SIZE or parallel.attn_tp_size != parallel.tp_size:
+        return None
+    return create_ll_comm(
+        parallel.tp_group.cpu_group,
+        torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device()),

+"""Hand a precomputed aiter moe_sorting result to the next aiter fused_moe call.
+
+A model whose router fuses the top-k with the route sort (Kimi-K3 on gfx950)
+stages the sorted routes here; the aiter runner's moe_sorting hook returns them
+instead of sorting again when the call is the one they were staged for.
+"""
+
+import contextlib
+from typing import Iterator, Optional

+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+
+class StagedSort(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor
+    block_m: int
+    sorted_ids: torch.Tensor
+    sorted_weights: torch.Tensor
+    sorted_expert_ids: torch.Tensor
+    num_valid_ids: torch.Tensor
+    # zeroed stage-2 accumulation buffer, the runner's zero-copy output
+    moe_buf: torch.Tensor
+    # Optional stage-1 MXFP8 activations for quant_input (the routed rows),
+    # standing in for aiter's fused_dynamic_mxfp8_quant_moe_sort.
+    quant_input: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    a1: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    a1_scale: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+
+
+class StagedQuant(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """Stage-1 MXFP8 rows an earlier kernel quantized: aiter then only sorts
+    their scales (mxfp4_moe_sort_fwd) instead of fused_dynamic_mxfp8_quant_moe_sort."""
+
+    quant_input: torch.Tensor  # the bf16 rows aiter would quantize
+    a1: torch.Tensor  # [M, D] fp8 e4m3
+    scales: torch.Tensor  # [M, D / 32] e8m0, token-major
+
+
+class _Handoff(msgspec.Struct):
+    staged: Optional[StagedSort] = None
+    quant: Optional[StagedQuant] = None
+
+
+_handoff = _Handoff()
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def stage(sort: StagedSort) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Publish `sort` for the aiter fused_moe call(s) inside the block."""
+    old, _handoff.staged = _handoff.staged, sort
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        _handoff.staged = old
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def stage_quant(quant: StagedQuant) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Publish `quant` for the aiter fused_moe call(s) inside the block."""
+    old, _handoff.quant = _handoff.quant, quant
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        _handoff.quant = old
+
+
+def sort_staged() -> bool:
+    return _handoff.staged is not None
+
+
+def active() -> bool:
+    return _handoff.staged is not None or _handoff.quant is not None
+
+
+def take(
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    block_m: int,
+    output: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    moebuf_dtype: torch.dtype,
+) -> Optional[tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]]:
+    """moe_sorting's return tuple when this call matches the staged sort."""
+    s = _handoff.staged
+    if (
+        s is None
+        or topk_ids.data_ptr() != s.topk_ids.data_ptr()
+        or topk_ids.shape != s.topk_ids.shape
+        or block_m != s.block_m
+        or output is None
+        or output.data_ptr() != s.moe_buf.data_ptr()
+        or output.shape != s.moe_buf.shape
+        or moebuf_dtype != s.moe_buf.dtype
+    ):
+        return None
+    return (
+        s.sorted_ids,
+        s.sorted_weights,
+        s.sorted_expert_ids,
+        s.num_valid_ids,
+        s.moe_buf,
+    )
+
+
+def take_quant(
+    input: torch.Tensor,
+    sorted_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    num_valid_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    token_num: int,
+) -> Optional[tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """The stage-1 (a1, a1_scale) when this quant call is the staged one: as

+    s = _handoff.staged

+        s is not None
+        and s.a1 is not None
+        and s.quant_input is not None
+        and input.data_ptr() == s.quant_input.data_ptr()
+        and input.shape == s.quant_input.shape
+        and input.stride() == s.quant_input.stride()
+        and sorted_ids.data_ptr() == s.sorted_ids.data_ptr()

+        q is None

+        or input.shape != q.quant_input.shape
+        or input.stride() != q.quant_input.stride()
+        or token_num != q.a1.shape[0]

+
+    a1_scale = mxfp4_moe_sort_fwd(
+        q.scales,
+        sorted_ids=sorted_ids,
+        num_valid_ids=num_valid_ids,
+        token_num=token_num,
+        cols=q.a1.shape[1],
+    )

+"""The gfx950 streaming attention-residual kernel against the register-tile kernel."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention import attn_res_hip as ar
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# backend-specific: the streaming bank read is selected on gfx950 only.
+register_amd_ci(est_time=15, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+# Kimi-K3: hidden 7168, up to 8 bank snapshots.
+H, NB = 7168, 9
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_gfx95_supported(), "gfx950 attention-residual kernels")
+class TestAttnResHipStream(CustomTestCase):
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_streamed_bank_matches_register_tile(self):
+        """Batches that read the bank a few rows at a time (online softmax) must
+        agree with the whole-bank register tile within one bf16 ulp, and write the
+        same prefix and bank snapshot bit for bit."""
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+        rnd = lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, generator=g, device="cuda")  # noqa: E731
+        T = ar.STREAM_MIN_ROWS + 37
+        prefix = (rnd(T, H) * 4).bfloat16()
+        addend = rnd(T, H).bfloat16()
+        cw = rnd(H) * 0.01
+        ow = (rnd(H) * 0.1 + 1).bfloat16()
+        for nvb in (5, 8):
+            for with_add, write_prefix in ((True, True), (False, False)):
+                bank0 = (rnd(T, NB, H) * 4).bfloat16()
+                outs = []
+                for stream_min_rows in (ar.STREAM_MIN_ROWS, 1 << 30):
+                    bank = bank0.clone()
+                    out = torch.empty(T, H, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+                    pre = torch.empty_like(out)
+                    saved, ar.STREAM_MIN_ROWS = ar.STREAM_MIN_ROWS, stream_min_rows
+                    try:
+                        ar.attn_res_hip(
+                            prefix,
+                            bank,
+                            cw,
+                            ow,
+                            out,
+                            nvb,
+                            1e-6,
+                            1e-6,
+                            addend=addend if with_add else None,
+                            prefix_out=pre if with_add else None,
+                            write_prefix=write_prefix,
+                        )
+                    finally:
+                        ar.STREAM_MIN_ROWS = saved
+                    outs.append((out.float(), pre, bank))
+                (o_s, p_s, b_s), (o_t, p_t, b_t) = outs
+                with self.subTest(
+                    nvb=nvb, with_add=with_add, write_prefix=write_prefix
+                ):
+                    beyond_ulp = (o_s - o_t).abs() > o_t.abs() * 2**-7 + 1e-3
+                    self.assertLessEqual(beyond_ulp.sum().item(), o_s.numel() // 1000)
+                    if with_add:
+                        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(p_s, p_t))
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(b_s, b_t))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
